reference.title: Server, Event Handler (bacnet-EventHandler)
reference.shortdesc: This component is a frozen container slot of the BacnetNetworkBacnet CommServer. It processes event notification messages and the acknowledgment of those messages, including ConfirmedEventNotification, UnconfirmedEventNotification, and AcknowledgmentAlarm.

section.p: To access these properties, expand ConfigDriversBacnetNetworkBacnet CommServer and double-click Event Handler.

property.propdesc: If the property is set to true, the event object can process silence requests. Conversely, if it is set to false, the device does not support silence functionality.
Selects the alarm class for a server event.

property.propvalue: number from 0 to a maximum (defaults to 0)
property.propdesc: Specifies the number of a text string that describes the alarm.

Formats text using values obtained from objects. The format string is specified as normal text with embedded scripts denoted by the % character. Calls within the script are mapped to an object's methods, and can be chained using the . dot operator. You can insert an A % character by using %%.
Examples of format strings are:
"my parent's name is %parent.displayName%", which will format the display name of an object's parent, using calls to the getParent() and getDisplayName() methods.
"%value% {%status.flagsToString%} @ %status.priority%", which will format the value, flags and priority of a status value.
In addition, there are several special functions available. These include:
"%time()%", which can be used to format the current time as a BAbsTime.
"%lexicon(module:key)%", which will get the specified lexicon text.
